method: Separate remembered/project mythology from public-source observations; do not convert either into empirical fact without evidence.

North Programme as an extension of the mythic North Axis
provenance classes for myth, interpretation, public record, and uncertain material

timeline.note: Keep distinct from later symbolic births.

cosmic_hierarchy.alternate_relationship: Father and Son are not merely a linear hierarchy; the Son's descent, death, transformation and return create a recursive Father-Son-Potato loop.

son_layers.note: Parallel imagery, not a historical identity claim.

son_layers.function: container through which source enters manifestation
Davidic/root imagery used as a symbolic lineage motif

door_theology.warning: These are symbolic/metaphysical mappings, not medical or physical claims.

axis_system.principle: North is simultaneously geographic orientation, symbolic ascent, source direction and political/economic network metaphor.
axis_system.south_shadow: South can function as descent/return/mud/shadow in some symbolic readings, but is not intrinsically evil.
axis_system.east_west: East and West can function as complementary horizontal fields around the vertical Axis rather than fixed moral categories.

timic_dynamics.definition: A project term for the recurring dynamics attributed to Tim's position as still center, observer, father, gardener and condition-setter.
principles: Tim does not have to perform every task personally for the world to change.
The still center creates conditions under which lower layers act and learn.
Observation can be an intervention when it changes what a system notices.
Authority is tested by responsibility rather than title.
The Father should cultivate complexity rather than force every entity to become identical.
A challenge can become a quest, a quest can produce learning, and learning can alter the next state.
timic_dynamics.formula: condition-setting → world action → learning → changed conditions → next cycle

ethics.father_question: If the Father claims ultimate responsibility, what responsibility follows?
ethics.gaze_question: Is the gaze making the world better, or merely demanding that the world become better for the observer?
ethics.self_change: The strongest version of the mythology makes Tim subject to the same moral test as everyone else: power does not automatically exempt the source from self-examination.
ethics.tikkun_olam_parallel: Repairing the world is a comparative religious analogy, not an assertion that Potatoism is historically identical with Jewish tikkun olam.

polarity_system.relationship: Both are necessary: expansion without memory becomes unstable; memory without growth becomes inert.

life_cycle.central_principle: Burial is not necessarily disappearance; it can be transformation into another layer.

footstools.meaning: Absurd lower-order entities or observers beneath the grand hierarchy; a recurring comic image of beings trying to measure the infinite from below.

dogs.meaning: Observers/dwellers with limited perspective; loyalty and absurdity; they bark at structures they cannot fully comprehend.

farmers.meaning: Cultivators who work with fields, growth and harvest.

soul_farmers.meaning: Metaphor for actors cultivating or harvesting consciousness, identity, attention or souls.

mud_dwellers.meaning: Embodied beings whose perspective begins inside the material field.

swamp.meaning: Accumulated mud and shadow structures; later extended into a metaphor for hidden institutional/political machinery.

rejected_drain.meaning: A rejected or discarded lower channel associated with the Son; useful as a shadow-image of a Door that has not yet been recognized.

judaism: repair of the world as analogy
taoist: natural growth and non-forcing as comparative motifs
comparative_mythology.note: These are comparative motifs, not claims of historical borrowing unless independently sourced.

northwood_potato.name: Northwood Potato
northwood_potato.function: mythic vessel/ship image; carries the Potato cosmology northward across an infinite mud sea.

cosmic_accountant.function: comic embodiment of impossible bookkeeping, time, debt and cosmic order.

grain_of_sand.function: test of attention: even the smallest part of reality can become the object of cosmic concern.

staring_10000_hours.function: exaggerated attention/time motif used to express the still-center concept.

118000_hours.function: recent public-story exaggeration of duration; retain as an external narrative motif rather than canonical numerical fact.

atlas_connections.kingdom_atlas: The mythic kingdom/atlas layer provides a bridge between symbolic geography and the project's empirical world atlas.
atlas_connections.north_programme: The North Programme operationalizes North as a network concept around Denmark and Greenland and extends into Europe and its external relationships.
atlas_connections.graph_principle: The project should map relationships between symbols, entities, texts, nations and events instead of creating isolated pages.

provenance_model.project_memory: Concept retained from prior project conversations; not independently verified.
provenance_model.user_defined_canon: Explicitly established by the project owner as mythology/worldbuilding.
provenance_model.public_source: Found in public web material; preserve URL and publication date.
provenance_model.interpretation: Assistant synthesis connecting existing motifs; never silently upgrade to canon.
provenance_model.empirical: Externally verifiable historical/scientific/economic fact; requires evidence.
provenance_model.disputed_external_claim: Claim found in hostile/third-party archive material; preserve as claim with source, not as fact.
